check_evidence.description: A signed NENRIN witness record exactly as GET https://ledger.horizonshield.dev/witness/<sha> serves it (record_canonical, signature_ed25519_b64, optional sha and public_key_ed25519_b64), bare or under {"record": ...}. record_canonical is a jidec-path-v1 conduct walk; the signature is Ed25519 over its UTF-8 bytes.

output_evidence.description: The presented witness record bytes, unmodified

claims.establishes: The record bytes are a canonical jidec-path-v1 record (sha256 recomputes when given), its witness key_url is on a domain the customer trusts and is not an operator domain, and its Ed25519 signature over those exact bytes verifies under the key the customer pinned for that domain.
limits: A signature shows who asserted the record, not that its assertions are true
Trusts the pinned key; the key the domain serves today, rotation and revocation are not checked in this version
Says nothing about Bitcoin anchoring: whether the ledger has batched and stamped the record is not checked offline here

claims.establishes: The walk was of exactly the endpoint configured for this workflow: the record's purpose names that URL byte for byte.
limits: Binds the endpoint only, not the tool, the action arguments, the tenant, the approval id or the operation id
The same record can be presented for any action dispatched to that endpoint

claims.establishes: On this endpoint every assertion of the walk passed (verdict PASS, n_pass equal to n_total), and the walk was made no more than max_age_s (default 604800) before the evaluation instant and not in its future beyond future_skew_s (default 300).
limits: A walk is one observation from one vantage at one instant; the endpoint may behave differently at another instant or from another vantage
Freshness uses the signed walked_at and the runtime's clock; there is no trusted time source
PASS covers the walk's own assertions (card stable, conduct extension declared and echoed, endpoint answered and bound), not the correctness or quality of any response

profiles.description: jidec-path-v1 record from a2a_conduct_walk.py (purpose 'a2a-conduct-walk-v1: <endpoint>'), sorted-key JSON without spaces, Ed25519 over its UTF-8 bytes, witness.key_url on the signer's domain

keys.purpose: verify witness signatures; the customer pins one Ed25519 public key per trusted witness domain (for example the key that domain serves at its witness key_url)
keys.lifecycle: pinned in config; no rotation or revocation in v0.1
